question: In Formula 1 seasons since 2001, considering only drivers who scored points in a season, which five constructors have had the most seasons where their drivers scored the fewest total points among all point-scoring drivers in that season?
sql:
-- Final answer: Top 5 constructors with most seasons where they had the fewest total points
WITH constructor_season_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, rc.constructor_id, c.name as constructor_name, SUM(rc.points) as total_points
    FROM results rc
    JOIN races r ON rc.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON rc.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001 AND rc.points > 0
    GROUP BY r.year, rc.constructor_id, c.name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY total_points ASC) as rn
    FROM constructor_season_points
),
fewest_per_season AS (
    SELECT year, constructor_id, constructor_name, total_points
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT constructor_name, COUNT(*) as num_seasons
FROM fewest_per_season
GROUP BY constructor_name
ORDER BY num_seasons DESC, constructor_name ASC
LIMIT 5;
